summary: The audit checks the required courses and 6 units of electives, all letter graded when that option is offered, two lab rotations in CBIO 399, and the reading and research course. Participation in CCRTP, three rotations in the first year and a thesis advisor by the end of first-year summer, the qualifying exam, the oral exam, the dissertation and the committee meetings are checked by hand. You must be registered every quarter.
